title: UK CPI — August 2026 consumer price inflation (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET), the last data the MPC sees before it votes
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukaugust2026, re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: August 2026', 'Release date: 16 September 2026 7:00am', and states 'This release is not yet published'. Corroborated from a second, independent ONS primary: the July 2026 bulletin (ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/bulletins/consumerpriceinflation/july2026, fetched direct 2026-09-09) carries 'Release date: 19 August 2026' and 'Next release: 16 September 2026', and the /latest redirect resolves to that same bulletin with the same next-release line. Primary-sourced (the publisher's own release calendar, twice), but filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit and because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: and no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of boe-decision-2026-09-17, 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-09, superseding proposals/uk-cpi-2026-09-16.from-boe-decision-2026-09-17.json (the BoE lane's discovery, read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md). That proposal's placement finding stands and is kept: this print lands 07:00 London the morning BEFORE the 2026-09-17 MPC announcement, where Greene, Mann and Pill already dissented for a hike at 6-3 in July. WHAT THE INITIAL RESEARCH ADDED: the print reduces to ONE arithmetic question, because August 2025 CPI rose 0.3% m/m (ONS Aug-2025 bulletin, fetched) against July 2026's 2.9% y/y — so the August 2026 y/y is 2.9% plus whatever this August's m/m clears 0.3% by. The tilt is up on primaries: air fares rose only 11.7% m/m in July 2026 against 30.2% in July 2025 (ONS July-2026 bulletin), so the August unwind that was the LARGEST DOWNWARD contributor in Aug-2025 has far less to give back; the Ofgem cap does not step between 1 July and 1 October, so gas/electricity are flat m/m by construction; petrol reached ~162p/l in August (press). Offsetting: food at 1.3% y/y and decelerating. Base case 3.0-3.2%, inside the BoE's own July-MPR path (peak ~3.2% in 2026 Q4). THE NUMBER THAT MATTERS FOR THE VOTE IS SERVICES, NOT HEADLINE, and the trap is that air fares sit inside services — so the same mechanical base effect that lifts headline also lifts services, 24 hours before three hawks vote. Tiered LOW, deliberately and after considering medium: symbols: [], no house playbook is rates- or sterling-keyed, and the only channel to this book is the second-order global term premium fomc-2026-09-16 already owns. Its real job is ATTRIBUTION on a crowded 09-16 (UK CPI 02:00 ET -> Bund 30Y auction -> US retail sales 08:30 -> FOMC 14:00 -> VIX expiration). Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Ledger: docs/research/events/uk-cpi-2026-09-16.md
